title: Observability: Enhance token/KV cost & latency dashboards, traces, and alert tuning
author: Ravi Patel
release_notes: Enhances token-level and KV cache observability: new dashboards, additional tracing tags, and tuned alert thresholds to reduce noise while preserving SLO coverage.
description: Context: token-level cost & latency dashboards are critical for understanding per-request economics when KV cache hits/misses change request behavior. Recent Dedicated workloads exposed blind spots: (1) KV cache hit rates are not surfaced alongside token-cost breakdowns, (2) tracing lacks request-level KV tags, and (3) alert thresholds for token-cost regressions were firing too frequently during expected traffic spikes. Motivation: consolidate token + KV metrics in dashboards, add tracing span tags for KV operations, and tune alerts to reduce false positives while keeping regressions visible. Changes in this PR: - New Grafana dashboard: obs/dashboards/token_kv_cost_latency.jsonnet that shows token-level cost, latency p50/p95/p99, KV hit/miss breakdown by model and route, per-route token distribution, and cost-per-token trend. - Added token-level metrics in telemetry/metrics/token_level.go: TokenTokensEmitted, TokenCostEstimate, TokenLatencyBucket with KV_hit boolean dimension. - KV metrics enrichment in telemetry/kv/kv_metrics.go: kv_hit_count, kv_miss_count, kv_latencies with model and route tags. - Tracing: added KV span tags in telemetry/tracing/span_tags.go and instrumented KV operations to attach kv.cache_hit and kv.key_group. - Alerts: updated platform/alerts/token_cost_alert.rules and platform/alerts/kv_cache_alert.rules to incorporate dynamic baselines and windowed evaluation (now 5m/30m combine) and to silence alerts during known traffic ramp windows. - Docs & runbook: docs/observability/token-metrics.md and docs/observability/alert-tuning.md. - Backfill script: scripts/backfill/token_metrics_backfill.py to backfill the new token-level metrics for the last 7 days to populate dashboards without an extended warmup. Testing & validation: unit tests added for metric serialization and KV tagging, end-to-end dashboard smoke tests verify panels render with sample data, and synthetic load run validated alert suppression logic across ramp scenarios. Rollout plan: feature flagged dashboard (obs.feature.token_kv_dash) and traced rollout in two stages: opt-in for staging teams for 48h, then enable for all infra accounts. Followups: add automated evaluation queries to the eval-harness to detect regressions in TokenCostEstimate for release gating (ENG-10034). Checklist: - [x] Metric names and tags reviewed with metrics team - [x] Dashboard panels reviewed with SRE & Observability PM - [x] Alert thresholds reviewed and tuned in staging - [x] Backfill script validated on staging - [x] Updated docs and runbook - [x] CI green Links: Dashboard preview: https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/preview/token-kv-cost-latency Linear: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-9842
